samples.name: prop-cabbage-sprout
samples.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Input images are STYLE references only. Single sprite for cozy medieval Slavic village farming game. Three tiny round pale-green cabbage leaves at center, occupying only 5x4 logical pixels; tiny seedling, no cabbage head. Strict 16x16 logical pixel grid enlarged to square canvas. Every logical pixel is one large solid square. Kenney Tiny Farm simplicity. Only three flat pale/sage green shades, light top-left, simple chunky silhouette. Top-down three-quarter south-facing view. Transparent background and gaps, no ground, shadow, pot or scenery. No gradients, antialiasing, haze, neon outlines, tiny veins, texture, text or extra subjects.
